name: NVIDIA H100 Tensor Core GPU datasheet (H100 SXM / PCIe / NVL)
notes: NVIDIA-authored H100 datasheet (doc 2430615) mirrored on a static host; nvidia.com's own resources.nvidia.com copy is a JS PDF viewer and does not expose text. Table covers H100 SXM, H100 PCIe and 2x H100 NVL. AUDIT FLAG: Spec-sheet content is NVIDIA's, but the PDF is hosted on a third-party webflow CDN, not on an NVIDIA domain. Publisher is recorded as NVIDIA because the document itself is NVIDIA-authored, but this is not a first-party-hosted URL - verify against resources.nvidia.com before treating as primary.
